get.description: Retrieves a list of KB article translation comments that are in the Recycle Bin, with pagination support.

parameters.name: deletedTimeRange
parameters.description: Filter trashed kb comments by deleted time. Enter the dates in the ISO date format of 'yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ'

parameters.name: deletedBy
parameters.description: Filters trashed comments to those deleted by the specified user

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of trashed comments to fetch

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which trashed article translations comments must be fetched

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts trashed comments by the specified attribute. Default sorting order is descending. Prefix the value with a hyphen (-) to sort in descending order. Possible values:deletedTime

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Filters trashed comments by the specified language locale

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Filters trashed comments to those under the specified category

post.description: Restores the specified article translations from the Recycle Bin to the help desk portal, including all associated parent entities.
